summary: Recruitment cancellation challenged; select list invalidated without inquiry; violation of reservation policy cited as reason; no rules framed for selection process; cancellation held disproportionate; defect curable without scrapping entire list; reliance on PCCF note without factual inquiry insufficient; High Court affirmed; proportionality and judicial review principles applied; writ jurisdiction available despite no vested right.
legal_provisions_cited: Shankarsan Dash v. Union of India
Union of India v. Rajesh P.U.
Sachin Kumar v. Delhi Subordinate Service Selection Board
Mohinder Singh Gill v. Chief Election Commission
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment upholding validity of select list upheld; cancellation of recruitment process set aside.
